summary: Comprehensive testing of the upgraded structured clinic application form at /za-kliniki#application. All 6 form sections (Clinic Info, Contact, Services, Qualification, Positioning, Operations) working correctly. Backend APIs and frontend form submission fully functional. All 21 backend tests passed, frontend form validation and submission verified.
passed_tests: Form loads at /za-kliniki#application with all 6 structured sections
Clinic Info section: clinic_name (text, required), city (dropdown with София/Пловдив/Варна/Друг), address (text, required), website (optional url)
Contact section: contact_name (required), phone (required), email (required)
Services section: 5 toggle switches for aligners, braces, implants, adults, children - all toggle correctly
Qualification section: years_experience (number), cases_per_month (dropdown 1-5/6-15/16-30/30+), digital_scans (yes/no dropdown)
Positioning section: textarea for patient types
Operations section: response time dropdown (<1h/1-6h/24h/>24h)
Backend POST /api/clinic-applications stores ALL fields correctly in DB with status='pending'
Backend GET /api/admin/clinic-applications returns all applications with all fields
Backend PATCH /api/admin/clinic-applications/{id} allows updating status and notes only
Form submission shows success message 'Благодарим за интереса'
Form validation: required fields (clinic_name, city, address, contact_name, phone, email) prevent submission when empty
Toggle switches toggle correctly between on/off states (aria-checked attribute updates)
All city dropdown options accepted: София, Пловдив, Варна, Друг
All cases_per_month options accepted: 1-5, 6-15, 16-30, 30+
All response_time options accepted: <1h, 1-6h, 24h, >24h
Digital scans converts yes/no to boolean true/false correctly
years_experience converts string to integer correctly
Admin authentication required for GET and PATCH endpoints
PATCH only allows status and notes fields (returns 400 for other fields)
PATCH returns 404 for non-existent application
critical_code_review_comments: ForClinicsContent.tsx well-structured with proper data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
Backend ClinicApplicationCreate model correctly defines all required and optional fields
Form correctly converts do_you_use_digital_scans from 'yes'/'no' string to boolean before sending to backend
Form correctly converts years_experience from string to integer before sending to backend
Toggle components use button[role=switch] with aria-checked for accessibility
Section dividers with icons provide clear visual separation between form sections
PATCH endpoint correctly restricts updates to only status and notes fields

success_rate.frontend: 100% (All form elements working, validation working, submission working)

seed_data_creation: Test clinic applications created with TEST_ prefix during testing (TEST_Playwright_Clinic_*, TEST_CLINIC_*)
